newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Second half Porgera gold output below target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Second half Porgera gold output below target.

text.p: Gold production at the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea in the second half of 1996 was 464,068 ounces, below the 500,000 ounce target set by the joint venture in mid-1996, Placer Pacific Ltd said on Friday.

"It had been expected that improved December quarter production would allow the 500,000 ounce target to be reached but problems were encountered with the primary gyratory crusher, resulting in lower mill throughput," Placer said.

Production for the December quarter was 250,508 ounces despite the unexpected downtime on the crusher, however, with higher underground gold grades partially offsetting the lower throughput, the company said.
"The crusher problems, which occurred from mid-November, have been rectified and Porgera management expect normalised crusher production in January, 1997," Placer said.

The Porgera Joint Venture planned to release a quarterly production report late in January. Porgera is 25 percent owned each by Placer Pacific, Highlands Gold Ltd, Goldfields Ltd, 15 percent by Orogen Minerals Ltd and 10 percent by the Papua New Guinea government.
Placer recently agreed to merge with its parent Placer Dome Inc. Placer Dome also owns just over 50 percent of Highlands Gold after a hostile takeover 75 cents a share bid which closes on Saturday.
